package persistence

  Expect(second.Get(\"shared\")).To(Equal(\"second\"))
  Expect(first.Delete(\"shared\")).To(Succeed())
  _, err := first.Get(\"shared\")
  Expect(err).To(Equal(model.ErrNotFound))
  Expect(second.Get(\"shared\")).To(Equal(\"second\"))
 })
})
EOF
